_meta.name: reliability-memory (E₀ lean core)
_meta.purpose: Self-contained build specification for a coding agent to implement the lean reliability-memory core distilled from the E₀ Framework. Hand this file to a coding agent; it contains every signature, formula, default, invariant, and acceptance test needed to build the package from scratch without reading the 36k-LOC parent repo.
_meta.derived_from: https://github.com/Thomas66690815/E0-Framework (e0_controller: primitives.py, historization.py, observation_port.py, mcp_adapter.py, tension.py, config.py)
_meta.design_principle: Historization is the dominant mechanism — other features add incremental value (E₀ bootstrap, confirmed 6×). Keep only the dominant mechanism plus epistemic trust and surprise dampening.
_meta.vocabulary: mainstream agent-engineering terms; E₀ canon term given in parentheses in 'e0_ref' fields

include: U/F success-failure traces with lazy global decay (ρ)
penalty (δ_H) = clip(λ_f·F − λ_s·U, ±δ_max) and cost R_eff = base_cost + penalty·trust
epistemic trust: trust = exp(−staleness/τ_doubt), self-calibrated τ_base
ReliabilityStore: observe / observe_edge / recommend / status with cold-start gate
MCP server surface (4 tools), optional dependency
exclude: inertia_factor and overlap modulation (not selected for lean core)

defaults._notes: epistemic_trust and adaptive default ON in the lean core (the two refinements are the point). surprise_dampening starts OFF and is toggled by the adaptive loop. delta/base_cost are per-edge; constants here are the auto-create defaults.

formulas.update: on outcome: U ← ρ·U + w·1[success]; F ← ρ·F + w·1[failure]   (w=0.5 on a dampened surprise, else 1.0)
formulas.lazy_decay: effective U,F at time τ = stored·ρ^(τ − τ_last). O(1) per access, identical to decaying every edge each step (E₀ K2).
formulas.cost: R_eff = max(base_cost + penalty·trust, 1e-10)   (trust=1 when epistemic_trust off)
formulas.ranking_cost: S_eff = delta · R_eff ; recommend = argmin over candidates (lower = more reliable)
formulas.tau_base: median of recent inter-visit intervals; fallback 10.0 when none
formulas.trust: trust = exp(−staleness / τ_doubt) ; 1.0 for virgin or just-visited edges
formulas.surprise: on a revisit (gap>1), predicted_success = (q_prev ≥ 0); surprise = (predicted_success ≠ actual_success)

spec.Outcome: Enum SUCCESS='success' FAILURE='failure' PARTIAL='partial' (PARTIAL is a non-canonical convenience; document the dropped-residual caveat)

modules.purpose: The trace engine. Holds per-edge U/F + decay + epistemic trust + surprise/adaptive. ~300 LOC.

methods._effective_traces(edge)->(u,f): apply lazy decay ρ^(τ−τ_last); return (0,0) for virgin
methods.update(edge, outcome)->None: catch-up decay; if gap>1 and edge seen: record confirmation/surprise (decayed by ρ^gap) and append gap to inter_visit window (cap=inter_visit_window, keep last 100 when exceeded); w=0.5 if surprise and surprise_dampening else 1.0; apply update formula; τ+=1; τ_last[edge]=τ
methods.adapt_from_experience()->bool: set surprise_dampening from classify (volatile=on, stable=off, exploratory=hold); return changed?

modules.purpose: Public API. Holds edges (delta, base_cost) + a Traces instance. Auto-creates edges on demand (bottom-up). ~200 LOC.

methods.observe(signal_id, outcome_str)->dict: aggregate outcome on Edge('port', signal_id); _count++; return {ok, signal_id, outcome, reliability, observations}
methods.observe_edge(source, target, outcome_str: ensure_edge; traces.update(Edge(source,target), outcome); if adaptive: traces.adapt_from_experience(); _count++; return ack
methods.recommend(state, candidates)->RecommendR: if no candidates or _count<min_observations: recommended=None with reason 'cold start (n/min)'. else ensure edges; pick argmin S_eff = delta·R_eff (R_eff uses penalty_trusted when epistemic_trust else penalty); reliability = q of chosen; reason = 'reliability selection (lowest cost)'
methods.save(path)/load(path): JSON: edges[{source,target,delta,base_cost}] + traces snapshot; load returns fresh store if file absent or malformed
methods._ensure_edge(source,target): add edge with default_delta, default_base_cost if absent

modules.RecommendResult: dataclass(recommended: Optional[str], reason: str, reliability: float, observations: int)

modules.purpose: Optional MCP surface. Requires `mcp` package; import lazily so the core works without it.
modules.notes: load store at startup, save after each mutating tool call. SESSION path from env var, default ~/.reliability_memory/session.json

invariants: Virgin edge (no traces) and just-visited edge: trust = 1.0.
recommend() returns recommended=None below min_observations_cold_start — never fabricate a recommendation on cold start.
Outcome.SUCCESS / Outcome.FAILURE are canonical; PARTIAL is a runtime convenience and its unresolved residual is dropped (document this; do not silently expand it).
Lazy decay must be mathematically identical to per-step global decay (verify with a test).
Edges are created bottom-up from observed outcomes; never require a pre-declared topology.
Persistence round-trip is exact: save → load reproduces identical recommend() behavior.
The core package has zero third-party dependencies; `mcp` is optional and imported lazily.

acceptance_tests.expect: recommend(...).recommended is None and reason starts with 'cold start'

acceptance_tests.given: many successes on e, then long gap with no visits
acceptance_tests.expect: effective U decays toward 0 by ρ^gap (assert within tolerance)

acceptance_tests.given: edge with strong penalty, then staleness grows
acceptance_tests.expect: penalty_trusted → 0 as staleness → ∞; cost returns toward base_cost

acceptance_tests.given: stable edge (always confirmed) vs volatile edge (often surprised)

acceptance_tests.expect: classify_experience()=='volatile' and adapt_from_experience() sets surprise_dampening True

acceptance_tests.given: a trained store saved then loaded
acceptance_tests.expect: recommend() identical before and after; tau, tau_last, confirmations, surprises preserved

acceptance_tests.given: fresh store, observe_edge on never-declared nodes

build_order: 2. traces.py (Traces) — depends on primitives; implement update + lazy decay first, verify T3
3. add trust/stability/tau_base to traces.py, verify T4/T5
4. add surprise tracking + classify + adapt, verify T6
6. save/load on store + traces snapshot, verify T7
7. mcp_server.py (optional) — wrap store in 4 MCP tools
8. run all acceptance_tests; ~600 LOC total target

integration.pattern: sidecar memory beside the LLM agent
integration.loop: rec = mem.recommend(state, candidates); action = rec.recommended or agent_choose(candidates); outcome = run_and_verify(action); mem.observe_edge(state, action, outcome); mem.save()
integration.sweet_spot: repetitive, long-running agents (support, ops, pipelines, recurring workflows) where context→action pairs recur
preconditions: a reliable SUCCESS/FAILURE signal (verification step preferred over LLM-judge)
a stable, deliberately-bucketed context_id scheme (too fine → no revisits; too coarse → collapse)
tolerance for cold start: recommend() returns None until min_observations reached
